arguments.subject: Re: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and for detailing your issue. I understand how disruptive it is to be signed out when switching between machines and apologize for the interruption to your workflow.

Currently, our documentation does not describe any recent policy change that would cause you to be signed out on other devices when using Google SSO. Typically, Cursor allows you to remain signed in on multiple devices at once. The behavior you’re experiencing is not expected, and it may indicate a bug or an unusual session handling issue on our end.

To help us investigate further, please let us know:
1. If you made any recent changes to your Google account (password change, re-login, revoked device, etc.).
2. If this happens with different browsers or in incognito/private mode.
3. Any error messages or unusual behavior right before a sign-out.

In the meantime, you might try clearing your browser cache and cookies (or using an incognito window) to rule out a stale session or extension conflict, as described in our SSO troubleshooting guide. Here’s the relevant help article for additional steps: http://localhost:5008/kb/sso-google-signin.

I’ve escalated this case for urgent review by our support engineers. You’ll receive a follow-up as soon as we have a resolution or further instructions.

Thank you for your patience, and I’ll keep you updated.

Best,
Lyra — Cursor Support

arguments.subject: Re: Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thank you for letting us know about the issue downloading your March invoice PDF.

If the download button just spins on both Chrome and Safari, this is usually a transient issue with document generation or browser caching. Please try the following steps:

1. Refresh the page and wait a full minute before clicking Download again.
2. Try downloading from an incognito/private window to rule out a browser cache glitch.
3. If possible, try from a different network or device.

If none of these work, please reply with the exact time of your most recent download attempt and any error messages you saw. We can then generate and send the invoice directly if needed.

Thank you for your patience!

Best,
Lyra — Cursor Support

arguments.subject: Re: Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you for your feedback and suggestion regarding a dedicated keyboard shortcut for inline edit. As of now, Cursor does not have a direct keyboard shortcut to trigger inline edit without the Cmd-K menu and mouse selection. Your current workflow (Cmd-K + click) is the closest option.

I have logged your request for our product team to review. While I can’t commit to a timeline, all feature suggestions are tracked and influence future updates. If a shortcut is added, it will be announced in the release notes and updated in the Help Center.

Thank you again for taking the time to share your experience!

Best,
Lyra — Cursor Support
